description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoGroupingRule更新自动转组规则
name: UpdateAutoGroupingRule

parameters.example: A项目线上资源自动转组规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.example: 带有标签 {"env": "online"} 和 {"project": "A"} 的资源转移到资源组rg-aek2********qcy
parameters.name: rule_desc

fields.help_en: The condition for the range of resources that are automatically transferred
fields.help_zh: 自动转组范围条件，用于指定需要自动转组的资源范围
fields.name: auto_grouping_scope_condition

fields.help_en: The ID of the content record
fields.name: rule_content_id

fields.help_en: The condition for the destination resource group
fields.help_zh: 目标资源组条件，用于指定自动转组的目标资源组
fields.name: target_resource_group_condition

parameters.help_en: The content records of the rule
parameters.name: rule_contents

parameters.help_en: The IDs of resource groups. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID范围，多个资源组ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of resource groups to be excluded. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID排除范围，多个资源组ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of regions. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID范围，多个地域ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of regions to be excluded. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID排除范围，多个地域ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of resources. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID范围，多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of resources to be excluded. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID排除范围，多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The resource types. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型范围，多个资源类型用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types_scope

parameters.help_en: The resource types to be excluded. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型排除范围，多个资源类型用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_types_scope
